name: Trickle Down API
description: Backend for Trickle Down, the daily charity day-trading game. Express + Postgres.

JWT_SECRET.description: Signs login tokens. Keep it secret; changing it signs everyone out.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call the API: your GitHub Pages URL and your custom domain.

FINNHUB_API_KEY.description: Free key from https://finnhub.io for stock prices. Leave blank to run with invented prices.

COINGECKO_API_KEY.description: Optional CoinGecko demo key; raises the crypto rate limit.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth Web client ID to enable Sign in with Google.

ADMIN_USERNAMES.description: Comma-separated usernames that get the Admin section (grant cash/lobbyists, reset) for testing.

GAME_TZ.description: The game day rolls over at local midnight in this zone.

LAUNCH_DATE.description: Day 1 of the game, YYYY-MM-DD, for the day counter.

DEMO_MODE.description: true while the charities are fictional; set false once src/charities.js lists real ones.

POOL_USD.description: Real ad revenue collected this quarter, shown on the Lobby page.

RIDE_TAX_FACTOR.description: Letting a winner ride is taxed at TAX_RATE times this (0.5 = half rate).

GUEST_TTL_DAYS.description: Guest accounts that never hired a lobbyist are deleted after this many idle days.

FINNHUB_BUDGET.description: Outbound Finnhub calls per minute we allow ourselves (their free tier is 60).

TOWN_INCOME_CAP.description: TrickleTown income can push the daily allowance past DAILY_CAP by at most this much.

RIDE_MAX_STEPS.description: How many rides keep raising the multiplier (stocks ×10 → ×20 → ×30) before it runs flat.
